reason: Clarify terminal accounting and summary units before locking or reading H10 outcomes.

changes.terminal_exit: Any position still open at the evaluation boundary is liquidated at the close of the last complete 4h bar before the boundary and charged one exit fill.
changes.trade_metrics: Win rate and profit factor use each closed position's stressed return on its allocated symbol slot.
changes.portfolio_metrics: Net return and drawdown scale each trade by the frozen one-sixth account allocation; closed-equity drawdown is ordered by exit time and does not include intratrade mark-to-market drawdown.
changes.monthly_metrics: Attribute each closed trade's one-sixth-scaled stressed return to its UTC exit month; include every calendar month touched by the evaluation interval, including zero-trade months.

change_policy_effect: No strategy feature, parameter, symbol, cost or date changed.
